scope: Read-only review of the final targeted-data expansion, exact-row evidence, public dataset receipt, and rebuilt Colab notebook. No examples or implementation were edited.

checks.name: Final source review
checks.result: Reviewed boost_data, the Arka pipeline extension, generic saved-review extension, publication auditor, data-only Hub publisher, notebook builder and embedded LoRA helpers. The final reference-notes supplement guidance and six-attempt bound preserve the existing acceptance gates. The earlier native-export, interrupted-swap and missing-overlap-evidence findings remain resolved. No blocking issue found.

checks.name: Focused offline tests
checks.command: uv run --locked pytest tests/test_boost_data.py tests/test_reviewed_publication.py tests/test_lora_notebook.py tests/test_public_parquet.py -q

checks.name: Actual committed data evidence
checks.result: Recomputed all 2,877 file hashes in the current manifest. Verified frozen data/SFT dev and validation hashes, and both original 1,000-row training prefixes against the saved pre-expansion hashes. Reconstructed all 1,684 SFT rows from their readable pairs and required context; every row matched exactly.

checks.name: All 500 additions and 961 saved Sol calls
checks.result: For every addition, checked the exact raw Sol request/result hashes, requested and returned model, complete finish reason, exact input/output/context packet and passing input/output/pair verdicts. All provider call IDs are distinct. Native payloads, six decision scores, judge model and final-export membership match the saved native records. There are 39 strong native routes with one Sol pass and 461 other complete non-vetoed routes with two separate Sol passes. The final 500-row overlap report matches the exact addition digest.

checks.name: Notebook consistency
checks.result: Every code cell parses. Embedded helpers have the same AST as lora_training.py. The notebook pins the published dataset revision and expected train/dev/validation counts of 1,500/100/84. Public dataset and base downloads use token=False. It downloads no code, manifests or review artifacts from Hugging Face. Only HF_TOKEN and WANDB_API_KEY are read from Colab Secrets. Train updates adapter parameters; dev selects the checkpoint; validation is evaluated after training. The final upload validates and sends adapter, tokenizer and model-card files to a model repository.

checks.name: Actual notebook CPU integration evidence
checks.result: Inspected the checker and the completed report bound to the exact final notebook/helper hashes. It encoded all 1,684 actual public Hub rows without truncation, with maximum chat length 4,029. Four optimizer steps changed LoRA parameters while base weights stayed unchanged. The saved adapter reloaded exactly. W&B ran offline and the model upload was mocked. This review did not rerun the optimizer.

checks.name: Hugging Face boundaries
checks.result: The publication receipt records the existing public training dataset at the new commit with 1,500/100/84 splits. Publisher source permits only Parquet data, dataset cards and license notices and verifies uploaded bytes. The separate 68-case calibration receipt is unchanged. The notebook loads the same pinned public training revision.

limitations: This is an implementation and evidence-integrity review. It is not an independent human semantic review of all examples or proof that the new data improves the student model.
The two Sol calls use the same model and rubric. They are separate provider calls, not independent human labels. Native probabilities remain uncalibrated and separate from model verdicts.

The reviewer did not repeat the costly full text-overlap comparison. The exact final overlap report was checked, and the publication auditor source independently recomputes that comparison. The parent completed the actual full audit before publication.

The reviewer made no model API calls or Hub API requests and did not publish or train. Public Viewer verification was still running during this review; the parent must retain its final result separately.

The CPU integration substitutes a tiny random native LFM, uses offline W&B and mocks the adapter upload. This review does not establish actual L4 execution, BF16 memory use, online W&B authentication, a new 230M adapter upload, or semantic validation gains.
